newsitem.title: USA: Unocal signs Caspian Sea oil production pact.
newsitem.headline: Unocal signs Caspian Sea oil production pact.

text.p: Unocal Corp on Monday said its Unocal Eastern Hemisphere Exploration Ltd. unit agreed to share production of a Caspian Sea oil prospect with the State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic (Socar).
Unocal holds a 25.5 percent interest in the block, which covers 450-square-kilometers of the Ashrafi and Dan Ulduzu oil prospects.
If exploration proves successful, Unocal said, total capital investment to develop the prospects could top $2.5 billion.

Exploration and production of the sites will be carried out by a consortium to include Amoco Corp at 30 percent, Itochu Oil Exploration Ltd. at 20 percent, Socar at 20 percent and Delta Oil Company of Saudi Arabia at 4.5 percent.
The agreement includes plans for a 3D seismic survey and drilling of three exploration wells. The consortium will also help upgrade a Socar drilling vessel.
